spans.text: An inconceivable pure white.
An endlessly extending snowfield, spreading bright beams of light through each and every corner of the world.
The body's weight recedes.
The all-repressing grasp of gravity loosens, and the body drifts towards another terminus...
Battle finished. Enemy HQ 90% destroyed.
Supplementary exam evaluation—pass.
Congratulations on completing your examination. Exiting...
Are we... back?
CMR-30 slowly returns to the realm of the living, clambering to her feet with an incredulous expression on her face.
Yo, rookie! Welcome back.
Straightening up, she finds Thompson and Type 80 around her.
C-Captain...
Thank goodness! We did it! We did it!!
Throwing her reservations out the window, CMR-30 springs forward, pulling the two into a hug with tears of joy.
Gack! Let go! I can't breathe!
Haha... Take it easy, Type 80!
This is an embrace from someone new to the business, filled with warmth and love!
CMR-30 sniffles, quickly letting go.
...Hm? Where's Miss Ceno?
Type 80 gestures—
A rifle bars the room's door assertively. Its owner, Ceno, stares at Kalina with nary a hint of charity in her eyes.
Ahem, I understand how you might be feeling.
No, Miss Kalina.
Punishment like this deserves an explanation, I would think.
It wasn't punishment, it was just a little, teensy tiny programming error.
I'm not buying it! What kind of error is that cursed? The Commander must've done this on purpose!
All I and Ceno did was turn in a few empty papers. Is that so bad to you?
Look, to show you how apologetic we are, the Commander will personally explain everything to you!
Thompson, help me calm them down.
Thompson shrugs.
Sorry, Kalina.
I think the Boss went a bit overboard this time.
Miss CMR-30!
Miss Kalina, I've come to understand something very clearly after that simulation—
My seniors here at Griffin are the best in the whole wide world! Anyone who makes them suffer deserves the worst!!
The fixtures in the room shed a pale light upon everyone's faces.
Commander! I've done everything I can! You'll have to handle the rest yourself!
I'll patch you through to the Commander right away.
Relax, you'll be compensated for sure!
Beep.
The tablet in Kalina's hands suddenly lights up with a new message, and she grasps onto it with unbridled joy like a lifeline in a moment of need.
It's the Commander!!
Look, see—see how serious the Commander is about this!
Kalina immediately opens the message, presenting it with both hands.
A lengthy silence follows.
The atmosphere in the classroom grows more and more morbid by the moment. Kalina furrows her brow, turning the tablet back towards herself with no small degree of confusion.
Kalin, I suddenly thought of something important today at work—
My yearly vacation from last year's about to expire!
I've already sent the request for my seven days of vacation to Mr. Kryuger. I'm already overseas.
I put some thought into the supplementary exams today...
I'll just leave everything associated with it to you, Kalina!
Give the folks compensation or whatever if you see fit...
See you after my holiday!
Beep.
The message ends.
DID YOU HEAR WHAT THE COMMANDER JUST SAID?!
Four pairs of eyes focus on the visibly shaken Kalina.
Miss Kalina!
I want doubled holidays!
I want doubled wages!
Miss Kalina, won't you do that for us?
Ahaha... O-of course!
The room instantly erupts with jubilation.
Kalina sighs with relief, wiping away the beads of sweat that are taking shape on her forehead.
Come to speak of it, I believe good times like these call for a drink!
C'mon!
We're all on double wages now, who cares! Let's drink like never before!
Let's go! To Squad Supplementary Exam's great triumph!
The group departs in a cluster, mirth and merriment in their presence...
Kalina silently does the math, wanting to cry but with nothing coming out.
Wait, since I'm fully in charge...
A flash of inspiration comes to Kalina.
Oh, I'll have one hell of a surprise for you... To thank you for ditching me half way...
Yes, I think I will see you after your holiday, Commander...
Kalina's face lights up as she leaps to her feet.
Bang!
The room's doors close with a slam.
Hurried footsteps, like a raging tempest, make their way to the ops room.
